label: Coastal Storm
summary: Storm surge from a hurricane or nor'easter. Exposure is concentrated on the Rockaway peninsula and around Jamaica Bay.

sections.title: Leaving the peninsula
sections.body: The Rockaways is a barrier peninsula reached by a small number of bridges and one subway line that crosses open water. Evacuation routes fill early and the A train is suspended before landfall. If you are told to leave, leave on the first notice rather than the last.
